description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Price on Rice
reasoning: This gazette content establishes regulatory price controls for rice varieties under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It constitutes a regulatory order (Order No. 54) issued under statutory powers (Section 20(5)) that sets maximum retail prices and rescinds a previous order, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, land, commercial, or other specialized category.
